31700-XIII.s: The bill formally establishes the 2009 budget statements (departmental and agency budgets) of the Ministry of Economic Affairs in thousands of euros, with commencement on 1 January 2009. The accompanying explanatory memorandum is largely a policy and budget overview with little delegation or power-shifting content.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2009 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

31792-VII.s: This bill amends the 2008 departmental budget statutes of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (chapter VII), including the operating-and-cost budgets of its service agencies, following the autumn budget memorandum (Najaarsnota). It sets the amended budget figures in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 December 2008.
q: The departmental budget statute of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2008 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statute attached to this law.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2008 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32123-XIII.s: This is the Dutch 2010 budget bill for the Ministry of Economic Affairs, setting the departmental budget statement and the budget statements for the Uitvoering and Telecom agencies in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum covers budget structure, deviations from central government budgeting rules, and policy and financial details across operational goals.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2010 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2010 wordt vastgesteld.

32222-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statute of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) in connection with the Najaarsnota, adjusting appropriations and revenue estimates in thousands of euros. It sets the amended budget statute as an annex and fixes entry into force from 1 December 2009 with retroactive effect where publication is late.
32222-XIII.j: The memorandum explains budget revisions (fines, CO2 auction timing, innovation and telecom spending) but does not justify any delegation or new executive power.
q: Whereas the need has arisen to amend the budget statute of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2009
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2009

32395-VII.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statutes of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) and the budget for its operating-cost-accounting services, as part of the spring memorandum adjustments. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force from 1 June 2010 with retroactive effect where publication is later.

32609-XII.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statements of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment and the operating-cost (baten-lastendiensten) budget, reflecting a departmental reorganisation. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 2 January 2011.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

32780-XII.s: The bill amends the 2011 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (XII), reflecting the Spring Memorandum adjustments, and sets the budget in thousands of euros. It also amends Article 66(5) and (6) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 to specify the reporting and audit opinion content of the ministry's internal audit service for 2011.
q: Article 4 Article 66, paragraphs five and six, of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 shall read as follows for the accountancy service of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment for the year 2011
Artikel 4 Artikel 66, vijfde en zesde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 komt voor de accountantsdienst van het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu voor het jaar 2011 als volgt te luiden

33280-XV.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, adjusting departmental and operational-service budget tables in thousands of euros following the spring memorandum. It is a budgetary adjustment that makes no new delegation of rule-making power or change to oversight.
q: Amendment of the budget statements of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2012
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2012

33640-XV.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget statutes of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (departmental budget and baten-lastendiensten budget), adjusting appropriations by article and total amounts in thousands of euros, following the Spring Memorandum. It sets the effective date as 1 June 2013 with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: We have deemed and resolved, with joint consultation of the States General ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for 2013 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd

34000-XVI.s: This bill sets the 2015 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (health, welfare and sport), including appropriations for policy and non-policy articles, and the 2015 budget statements for its baten-lastenagentschappen. It fixes the budget figures in thousands of euros and provides that the act takes effect on 1 January 2015, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2015 annexed to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34085-XII.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment and the budgets of its agencies, through a second supplementary budget. It changes appropriations for policy articles such as water, climate, aviation and supervision, and does not delegate rule-making or shift powers.
q: At the Autumn Memorandum the commitment and expenditure budget was raised by EUR 0.9 million, among other things for carrying out cabotage supervision tasks.
Bij Najaarsnota is het verplichtingen- en uitgavenbudget met € 0,9 miljoen verhoogd onder andere voor uitvoering van de toezichtstaken cabotage.

34235-(R2053).s: The bill approves on behalf of the Kingdom of the Netherlands Protocol No. 16 to the European Convention on Human Rights, which lets designated national supreme courts request non-binding advisory opinions from the European Court of Human Rights. The explanatory memorandum designates the Supreme Court, the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State, the Central Appeals Tribunal, the Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal and the Joint Court of Justice of Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten and the BES islands as competent courts.
34235-(R2053).j: The memorandum justifies the protocol as strengthening dialogue between national courts and the European Court and reducing the number of individual complaints by letting domestic courts obtain advisory opinions on the Convention.
q: Specifically designated national courts are given the power to ask the Court for an advisory opinion on questions of principle concerning the interpretation or application of the rights and freedoms in the Convention or its Protocols.

Specifiek aangewezen nationale gerechten krijgen de bevoegdheid het Hof te verzoeken om een advies over principiële (rechts)vragen aangaande de interpretatie of toepassing van de rechten en vrijheden neergelegd in het Verdrag of de daartoe behorende Protocollen.

parties: Asks whether the advisory opinions would in effect become binding, whether the Court's workload would really fall, and how long advisory proceedings would delay national cases.
Is it correct that the advice thereby becomes quite binding?
Klopt het dat het advies hierdoor wel erg dwingend wordt?
Argues the government did not adequately answer the Council of State's point that advisory opinions are de facto binding on national courts and asks for a fuller justification.
In the view of these members, the government has not adequately responded to the Council of State's questions with this reply.
Naar de mening van de voornoemde leden is de regering met deze reactie onvoldoende ingegaan op de vragen van de Afdeling.

Asks what the basis is for expecting reduced workload at the Court, whether parties can request advisory referral, and how parties can comment on the facts given that facts are no longer contested before Dutch supreme courts.
Everyone retains the right to still lodge a complaint, even if the national judge has followed the ECtHR's advice.
Een ieder behoudt het recht alsnog een klacht in te dienen, ook al heeft de nationale rechter zich aan het advies van het EHRM gehouden.

Questions whether advisory referrals will initially increase the Court's workload, whether the examples of mass identical complaints are real, and whether national courts could be penalised for delay caused by the advisory procedure.
Will this form of advisory procedure in any case in the short term actually lead to an increase in the workload at the Court?
Zal deze wijze van advisering in elk geval op korte termijn juist voor een verhoging van de werkdruk bij het Hof zorgen?

Welcomes the protocol but asks why the Council for the Judiciary has not advised, why there is no financial section, whether the Human Rights Institute should be designated, and how the Court's political vulnerability and the margin of appreciation are handled.
They note that the College for Human Rights, which rules under the Equal Treatment Act, has not been designated for this purpose.
Het valt hen op dat het College voor de Rechten van de Mens, dat oordeelt op basis van de wet gelijke behandeling, hiertoe niet is aangewezen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division endorses the bill approving Protocol No. 16 to the ECHR but raises remarks on the explanatory memorandum: the stated aims of strengthening subsidiarity and reducing the ECtHR's workload are insufficiently analysed, advisory opinions may be factually binding, and there are concerns about procedural length, overlap with the CJEU preliminary reference procedure, case-handling and consultation. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks and amends the explanatory memorandum, but rejects the factual-binding point and the political-waters point.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the Protocol will substantially reduce the ECtHR's workload and asks for fuller explanation in the memorandum, which the government largely addressed by supplementing the text.

The Afdeling argues the memorandum must address how the advisory procedure strengthens subsidiarity and the risk of the ECtHR being drawn into politically sensitive matters; the government supplemented subsidiarity but rejected the political-waters passage as speculative.

The Afdeling considers advisory opinions factually binding in almost all cases and asks the memorandum to address this; the government holds that national courts retain the power to rule differently and left the text unchanged.

The Afdeling asks the memorandum to address the effect of the advisory procedure on the length of national proceedings under Article 6 ECHR and the possibility of a time-out, which the government added.
The Afdeling asks the memorandum to explain the relationship between the advisory procedure and the CJEU preliminary reference procedure where the EU Charter applies, which the government added.
The Afdeling asks that parties be allowed to comment on the factual account submitted to the ECtHR, and the memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
The Afdeling asks whether the designated highest courts were consulted on the proposal, which the government addressed in the memorandum.

34515-(R2070).s: The bill approves for the entire Kingdom of the Netherlands the 2016 maritime boundary treaty with France in the Caribbean, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It sets the entry-into-force date and orders publication in the Staatsblad and in the official gazettes of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten.
q: The Treaty provides for a delimitation between all maritime zones to which both States may claim entitlement under the law of the sea.
Het Verdrag voorziet in een afbakening tussen alle maritieme zones waar beide Staten op grond van het zeerecht aanspraak op kunnen maken.

parties: Asks about the timing and status of future tripoint agreements with the United Kingdom and Saint Kitts and Nevis.
Does the Minister have any indication of when the treaty between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the United Kingdom will or can be signed?
Heeft de Minister enige indicatie wanneer het verdrag tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en het Verenigd Koninkrijk zal of kan worden getekend?
Sees no reason to ask questions about the treaty.
The said members see no reason to ask questions.
De genoemde leden zien geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen.
Asks why negotiations took so long, the costs, coast guard consequences, and requests that the negotiation documents be made public.
Finally, the PVV members would like to know whether the documents of the negotiations on this maritime delimitation can be made public.
Tot slot willen de leden van de PVV-fractie graag weten of de stukken van de besprekingen van deze maritieme afbakening openbaar gemaakt kunnen worden.
Sees no reason to ask questions about the treaty.
The said members see no reason to ask questions.
De genoemde leden zien geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen.

34960-VII.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budgets of its executive agencies through a first supplementary budget. It changes appropriations and receipts across policy articles such as housing, energy, and civil service management.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2018 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35095-VII.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statement for its agencies, in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 1 December 2018 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: We Willem-Alexander, by the grace of God, King of the Netherlands, Prince of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Willem-Alexander, bij de gratie Gods, Koning der Nederlanden, Prins van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

35210-XIII.s: The bill amends the 2019 budget statutes of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and of its agencies, adding about EUR 332 million in commitments and EUR 301 million in expenditure through a first supplementary budget. It also sets the effective date of the amendment as 1 June 2019, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and of the budget statement for the agencies of this ministry, all for the year 2019

Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2019

35300-XIII.s: This bill fixes the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII), including its policy articles and non-policy articles, in thousands of euros. It also sets the 2020 budget statements for the agencies (agentschappen) Telecom, ICT Uitvoering, Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit and RVO.nl, with the accompanying memorandum describing spending and oversight arrangements.
q: Whereas, under Article 105 of the Constitution, the budget of government expenditure and receipts must be established by law.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat ingevolge artikel 105 van de Grondwet de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het Rijk bij de wet moet worden vastgesteld

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 9 September 2019 that it had no remarks on the 2020 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) for the ministries and funds, including the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, and recommended submitting them to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport of 16 September 2019 states that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes not included in this text.

35350-XV.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (second supplementary budget), changing appropriations across policy articles. It makes no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to oversight or legal protection.

35570-XII.s: The bill formally establishes the 2021 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and the budget statements for its agencies, including Rijkswaterstaat, ILT and KNMI, in thousands of euros. It sets entry into force on 1 January 2021, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management for the year 2021, attached to this act, is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that it had no remarks on the 2021 budget bill for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat and recommended submitting it to the House of Representatives. The government's nader rapport confirms this and notes that adjustments to several budgets were needed.

35975-IX.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2021 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), mainly reallocating tax and debt-management appropriations in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum justifies the changes through budget variances such as lower staffing costs, lower interest on short-term debt, and a reduced need for market borrowing.
35975-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to lower-than-expected volumes, contract revisions, and cost savings in various budget articles.
q: Interest income on short-term debt is expected to be €221 million lower, mainly due to lower use of the money market than estimated.
De rentebaten op de vlottende schuld vallen naar verwachting € 221 mln. lager uit, met name als gevolg van een lager beroep op de geldmarkt dan geraamd.

36027-(R2160).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom of the Netherlands the 2004 UN Convention on Jurisdictional Immunities of States and Their Property, and adds a reservation to article 18 applying the conditions of article 19(c) to interim (conservatory) measures against state property. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
36027-(R2160).j: The memorandum justifies ratification by arguing the Convention codifies customary international law that Dutch courts already apply, so ratification is a logical next step.
q: Now that it has become clear that Dutch judges also largely regard the Convention's provisions as a reflection of customary law, ratification of the Convention codifying these rules is an obvious next step.

Nu gebleken is dat ook de Nederlandse rechters de bepalingen van het Verdrag grotendeels zien als een weergave van het gewoonterecht, is de ratificatie van het Verdrag dat deze regels vastlegt een voor de hand liggende volgende stap.
p: The reservation to article 18 permits conservatory measures against foreign state property under defined conditions, which narrows immunity protections for foreign states rather than shifting power to the Dutch executive.

parties: Asks whether the 2006 CAVV advice is still current, which parts were followed, and why its advice on Article 11 reservations was not followed.
To what extent is the 2006 CAVV advice still current?
In hoeverre is het CAVV-advies uit 2006 nog actueel?
Asks whether the convention can be overridden if state security is at stake and what procedure applies, and how it relates to EU law and investor-state dispute clauses.

These members ask the government whether there are means, if desired after Netherlands signature, to override the convention if state security is at stake and what procedure has been established for that.

Deze leden vragen de regering of er middelen zijn, indien dat gewenst is na ondertekening door Nederland, om het verdrag te overrulen in het geval de staatsveiligheid in het gedrang is en welke procedure daar dan voor is vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft rijkswet approving the 2004 UN Convention on Jurisdictional Immunities of States and Their Property, asking for clearer explanation of implementation in Dutch law, the relation to the European Convention on State Immunity, the reservation on conservatory measures, and extension to the whole Kingdom. The government's nader rapport reports that most points were followed by amending the explanatory memorandum, while maintaining that no further changes to the Dutch civil procedure code are needed.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for an explanation of which points of the Convention differ from Dutch rules and practice, including the CAVV-identified points; the government did not respond point by point but consulted the Adviescommissie voor burgerlijk procesrecht and stated no remaining differences.
The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address the relation between the Convention and the existing European Convention on State Immunity; the government added that both are compatible.
The Afdeling advised explaining the substantive reasons for the reservation on conservatory measures; the explanatory memorandum on article 18 was amended accordingly.

The Afdeling advised pursuing accession for the whole Kingdom or explaining how it can be achieved quickly; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented, but Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten have not yet committed.

36200-XIII.s: This is the 2023 budget bill (Voorstel van wet) for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, setting departmental expenditure and income tables and the budgets of its executive agencies in thousands of euros. It establishes the 2023 budget appropriations and the entry-into-force rule, and the explanatory extract describes funding for energy saving obligations, the National Growth Fund, Groningen and coronavirus support programmes.
q: The departmental budget statement attached to this act for the year 2023 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State had no remarks on the 2023 budget bill for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes to the report.

36250-XV.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2022 departmental expenditure statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, changing commitments and expenditures across policy articles such as labour market, social assistance, disability, childcare and integration. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the act effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2022.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment for the year 2022.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid voor het jaar 2022.

36321-(R2181).s: The bill approves for Curaçao the 2015 tax treaty between the Kingdom of the Netherlands (for Curaçao) and Malta on avoiding double taxation and preventing fiscal evasion on income taxes, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The treaty of 18 November 2015 between the Kingdom of the Netherlands, for Curaçao, and the Republic of Malta on avoiding double taxation and preventing fiscal evasion on income taxes
Het op 18 november 2015 tot stand gekomen Verdrag tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden, ten behoeve van Curaçao, en de Republiek Malta tot het vermijden van dubbele belasting

parties: Notes that Curaçao's treaty ratification depends on the Netherlands and that the process stalls, but asks other fracties not to obstruct the bill and asks the Tweede Kamer not to request a debate.
The fraction asks the other fractions in the Staten not to oppose this proposed Rijkswet, because it is in Curaçao's advantage.
De fractie vraagt aan de overige fracties in de Staten om dit voorstel van Rijkswet niet tegen te werken, omdat het in het voordeel is van Curaçao.

Argues Curaçao is not truly free to conclude treaties, that the Tweede Kamer can amend the text without Curaçao's consent, and that Curaçao should have the final word on treaties affecting its interests.
Finally, the fraction is of the opinion that Curaçao, also regarding the conclusion of international treaties that particularly affect Curaçao's interests, must have the last word.
Tot slot is de fractie van mening dat Curaçao, ook ten aanzien van het sluiten van internationale verdragen die met name de belangen van Curaçao raken, het laatste woord moet hebben.
Supports the treaty but asks why the Dutch government did not incorporate the Raad van State's drafting remark on the entry-into-force provision.
why has the Dutch government not incorporated the editorial remarks of the Raad van State regarding article 2 into the proposed Rijkswet?
waarom heeft de Nederlandse overheid de redactionele opmerkingen van de Raad van State met betrekking tot artikel 2 niet meegenomen in het voorstel van Rijkswet?

Supports the treaty's benefits but questions the delay since 2015, asks what Curaçao can do to speed the process, and wants a more proactive Curaçaose stance and an explanation of Kingdom treaty procedure under the Statuut.
The fraction expects a more proactive attitude from Curaçao in answering the questions in this process.
De fractie verwacht een meer proactieve houding van Curaçao bij de beantwoording van de vragen in dit proces.

Objects that the treaty text was not supplied to the Staten and was only online, that the Staten were not consulted before the bill reached this stage, and asks what role the parliament has under the Kingdom; also raises questions on treaty articles affecting residency and the online gaming sector.
Here the question arises what the role of the parliament is within the Kingdom, which deals with Rijkswetten and treaties.
Hier rijst de vraag wat de rol van het parlement is in het kader van het Koninkrijk die zich bezighoudt met rijkswetten en verdragen.
Asks why there was a long gap between concluding and ratifying the treaty and whether relevant OECD model changes were covered by the MLI.
Members of the VVD group ask whether the government can explain why so much time passes between concluding the treaty and ratifying it.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven waarom er zo veel tijd zit tussen het afsluiten van het verdrag en ratificatie van het verdrag?
Has no comments on the bill.
These members have no comments on the bill.
Deze leden hebben geen opmerkingen bij het wetsvoorstel.
Asks whether the treaty makes tax avoidance easier and whether it is sufficiently guaranteed that both parties verify fair taxation.
Members of the SP group ask the government to explain whether tax avoidance becomes easier with this treaty.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering om uit te leggen of belasting ontwijken niet eenvoudiger wordt met het onderhavige verdrag.
Asks for explanation of the delay, the absence of an evaluation clause, budgetary effects, and why the treaty has not followed BEPS standards since 2017.
Finally, these members ask the government to explain further why no evaluation provision has been included.
Tot slot verzoeken deze leden de regering om nader toe te lichten waarom er geen evaluatiebepaling is opgenomen.
Questions why the bill was submitted only now and why the 2015 BEPS minimum standards were not added to the treaty.
Members of the D66 group note that the treaty does not yet contain the minimum standards of the OECD BEPS project.
De leden van de D66-fractie zien dat het verdrag nog niet de minimumstandaarden uit het OESO Base Erosion and Profit Shifting project (BEPS) bevat.
Expresses concern that the treaty does not meet OECD minimum standards, asks why it deviates from the model treaty, and stresses that Curaçao's fiscal autonomy requires trust in integrity.
Member Omtzigt has difficulty with the fact that this treaty does not meet the OECD minimum standards published in 2015.
Moeite heeft het lid Omtzigt met het feit dat dit verdrag niet voldoet aan OESO-minimumstandaarden die in 2015 openbaar zijn gemaakt.
Asks how the expected revenue can be claimed without quantification, and about Malta's role in tax avoidance and potential consequences for Curaçao.
Nevertheless, the government states that there will be a "positive economic effect [...] and is expected to yield revenue for the treasury."
Desondanks stelt de regering dat er wel een « positief economisch effect zal zijn [...] en naar verwachting een opbrengst voor de schatkist zal opleveren ."
Notes the treaty does not meet the BEPS minimum standards and asks whether Curaçao and Malta will notify it under the MLI.
The VVD members note that the tax treaty itself does not meet the BEPS minimum standards.
De leden van de VVD-fractie constateren dat het belastingverdrag zelf niet voldoet aan de BEPS-minimumstandaarden.
Questions unclear prior government answers, the delay since 2015, deviations from the treaty policy note, and risks that the treaty enables routing of online gambling profits and illicit funds.

These members ask whether the government agrees that the Curaçao-Malta treaty opens routes to channel profits of remote gambling providers earned anywhere in the world, including the Netherlands, to companies or individuals in third countries.

De leden van de NSC-fractie vragen of de regering het eens is dat het verdrag Curaçao-Malta routes opent om de winsten van aanbieders van kansspelen op afstand waar ook ter wereld behaald, waaronder dus ook Nederland, door te sluizen naar vennootschappen of natuurlijke personen in derde landen.
Asks which treaty provisions would have been at risk without the MLI and which parts of the 2017 OECD model update the government values most.
The BBB members ask the government to indicate which concrete treaty provisions would have been jeopardised had Malta and Curaçao not conformed to the MLI.
De leden van de BBB-fractie vragen de regering om aan te geven welke concrete verdragsbepalingen in gevaar waren gekomen in het geval Malta en Curaçao zich niet hadden geconformeerd aan het MLI.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State gave no substantive remarks on the Netherlands-Curaçao-Malta double tax treaty, only a redactional remark on the entry-into-force period, and advised submitting the treaty to parliament and the Staten van Curaçao. The minister's nader rapport declined the redactional remark but amended the explanatory memorandum on BEPS, the dividend withholding tax, the expired savings directive and binding provisions.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for at least one month between Staatsblad publication and entry into force to allow publication on Curaçao; the government did not follow this and kept entry into force the day after publication.

36470-XII.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2023 budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat and the budget statements of its agencies (RWS and KNMI), in thousands of euros, effective from the day after publication and retroactive to 1 December 2023. The explanatory memorandum covers budget reallocations for the Bodemsanering scheme, ICT work, the Banenafspraak, energy-label supervision and smaller expenditure changes.
36470-XII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the Omgevingswet transition, ICT project needs and other expenditure shifts, not by any new delegation of power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat voor het jaar 2023

36560-XII.s: This slotwet amends the 2023 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and its agencies, adjusting appropriations, expenditure and receipts to realised figures. It contains no delegation of rule-making power or changes to institutional checks, and the explanatory extract only reports underspending and budget shifts.
q: Fewer applications were received in 2023 than expected.
Er zijn in 2023 minder aanvragen binnen gekomen dan verwacht.

36625-VII.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statement for its agencies, adjusting appropriations and cash flows in the second supplementary budget. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law take effect the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2024.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) and of the budget statement on the agencies of this ministry, all for the year 2024

Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2024

36740-XII.s: This slotwet amends the 2024 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat (HXII) and of its agencies, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts per article to the realised figures. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat for the year 2024 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36850-VII.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations and the agency budget, mainly reallocating and reducing spending for the Groningen earthquake damage programme. It adjusts appropriations, revenues and agency balances in thousands of euros and enters into force retroactively from 1 December 2025.
q: We have deemed it appropriate ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for 2025 is amended

Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd
